title: Maktaba plugin panel (ui/panel.json), ui@1
description: Epic 54 story 54.20. A panel is data: a title and up to 10 blocks from a fixed set, each fed by one key of the plugin's data for the subject (the image block by the plugin's panel artwork). Labels are keys into the plugin's i18n files. Every value is plain text: no URLs, HTML, markdown or control characters. Read by shared/plugins/pluginpanel (Go) at install and on every write of a key a panel uses.

x-values.kv: [{"label": text, "value": text or number}], at most 20
x-values.chips: [text], at most 20; tapping one searches Maktaba for its text
x-values.table: [[text or number, ...], ...]: at most 50 rows of at most the block's columns (at most 6)
x-values.markers: [{"t_ms": integer, "label": text}], at most 200; shown only when written after the video's file last changed
x-values.image: no key: the PNG or JPEG the plugin set with artwork.write kind "panel" (at most 1 MB), served by the home
x-values.text_limit: every other text at most 200 characters
